svg.aria-label: A is a constructed 8-second first-order thermal response with complete transition heat about 45 J/g. B redraws public values from Fortin et al., NIST SP 260-242, Table 4: posterior means and reported 95% credible bounds. Zero rate is an extrapolation. NIST government research data, credited with original values retained.
